subject: MSA & Order Form: template selection, signer data, and redline priority
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Amy Lin <amy.lin@novatel.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA & Order Form: template selection, signer data, and redline priority

Amy —

Thanks for sending the opportunity details over. Before we start formal redlines on the MSA and Order Form, two quick asks so we can scope the first-pass and set the sprint cadence: 

1) Template preference: do you want Novatel's MSA (attached) to be the baseline, or would you prefer we use Redwood's standard MSA and capture Novatel exceptions in an Exhibit/side letter? If you have a legal preference, let me know — otherwise we'll propose Redwood baseline + exceptions.

2) Signer & procurement contacts: please confirm the authorized signer name/title/email for signatures and the procurement / legal contacts who will review redlines. We need point people to avoid looping delays.

3) Timeline & priority clauses: the customer has indicated a target go-live 2027-06-01. If that stays, we recommend a 2-week redline sprint with a single round of back-and-forth (internal review, one negotiated pass). Please flag any clauses that must be prioritized (e.g., data residency, liability cap, SLA).

Attachments: Novatel_MSA_Draft_v1.docx (your draft) — I included ExhibitA_pricing.xlsx for internal reference but happy to swap if you have an alternate.

What I will do next: Kimberly will do a first-pass redline mapping (template gaps + clause heatmap). Marissa will lead the order-form pricing review. Jonas will own the negotiation timeline and escalation path.

Can you confirm template preference + signer(s) by EOD Tue (2027-04-13)? If you prefer a quick sync, I can set a 30-minute kickoff next week.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

From: Amy Lin <amy.lin@novatel.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Baxter <tim.baxter@novatel.com>, procurement@novatel.com
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form: template selection, signer data, and redline priority

Thanks, Irene —

We generally prefer to use the counterparty (Novatel) MSA as the baseline for large platform vendors; that said, we're open to Redwood's baseline if you can provide a short exceptions list for any material differences. For speed, starting from our draft may be quicker for procurement.

Signer & contacts:
- Tim Baxter, Director of Procurement (tim.baxter@novatel.com) — primary signer
- Legal reviews: contracts-team@novatel.com (monitored by Amy and team)

Timeline: target go-live is aspirational; procurement wants executed docs by 2027-05-20 if possible. We're flexible but would like to avoid protracted negotiations.

Priority clauses we will focus on: data residency (EMEA carve option), liability cap (prefer 3x fees), and IP ownership for co-developed integrations.

I've attached our MSA draft. Let me know if you'd like a short kickoff call — Tim can join next Tue/Wed morning PST.

—Amy
Amy Lin
Sr. Contracts Manager, Novatel Systems
amy.lin@novatel.com
Attachment: Novatel_MSA_Draft_v1.docx (file stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: first-pass redline plan & clause priority (Novatel)

Irene / team —

I reviewed Novatel_MSA_Draft_v1 and sketched a pragmatic approach for the sprint:

Overview & recommended baseline
- Use Novatel's MSA as baseline (per Amy) and prepare a Redwood exceptions summary document. That reduces churn on their side and lets us call out carve-outs.

Top priority redlines (first-pass focus) — aim to resolve these in round 1: 
- Liability & cap: propose Redwood cap = 1x annual committed fees with carve-outs for gross negligence and data breach; prepare fallback positions.
- Data residency & transfer: confirm whether Novatel requires EMEA-only residency; if yes, propose a scoped exhibit for EMEA workloads and routing policy.
- IP & derivatives: clarify license scope for embeddings/derived features and provide a narrow license back for integration code.
- Indemnity & third-party claims: limit obligations to Redwood's direct systems and exclude partner services where reasonable.
- SLA credits & measurement: ask for objective metrics + reasonable cure windows rather than immediate credit triggers.

Operational plan
- Marissa: order form pricing alignment and Exhibit A updates (I attached ExhibitA_pricing.xlsx).
- Jonas: lead negotiation cadence and escalation matrix (30/60/90).
- I'll produce a clause heatmap and preliminary redline (tracked) by Tue EOD (2027-04-13).

Proposed timeline (aggressive):
- Tue 2027-04-13: internal first-pass complete
- Wed 2027-04-14: send tracked redlines to Novatel
- Thu-Fri 2027-04-15/16: negotiation window / quick follow-ups

Open Qs (need answers from Amy / Novatel):
1) Confirm whether Novatel will accept an Exhibit for EMEA residency or expects the whole contract changed.
2) Does Tim have signature authority, or do we need an additional officer?

Irene — flag anything else you'd like prioritized.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Contracts Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: ExhibitA_pricing.xlsx (file stub)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Amy Lin <amy.lin@novatel.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form: template selection, signer data, and redline priority

Amy —

Appreciate the quick reply and the timeline clarity. We're aligned: we'll start from Novatel's draft and return a tracked redline plus a one-page exceptions summary. Proposed next steps below — happy to confirm during a 30-min kickoff.

Action items & owners:
- Kimberly: draft tracked redlines (priority clauses called out) — deliver Tue EOD (2027-04-13)
- Marissa: update Exhibit A with pricing and licensing flags — deliver Tue EOD
- Irene: coordinate legal/CS/infra reviewers and consolidate comments
- Jonas: schedule negotiation windows; point of escalation if terms need exec sign-off

Kickoff suggestion: Wed 2027-04-14 @ 09:00 PST — 30 minutes. Agenda: review top 5 redlines, confirm EMEA residency approach, and agree on signatory authority and DocuSign path. Tim / Amy — can you confirm availability?
